description: The pie chart presents the distribution of items across three years for the paper “Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse,” showing a total of three slices labeled 2017, 2018, and 2019. The 2017 slice is green and labeled 21.0% (21), the 2018 slice is orange and labeled 33.0% (33), and the 2019 slice is blue and shows the count (46) with the percentage not clearly visible but visually representing the remaining share (approximately 46%). Percentage-and-count labels appear inside the 2017 and 2018 slices, while the 2019 slice displays only the count in parentheses; there is no separate legend, no exploded or offset segments, and the slices do not appear to be arranged in a strictly descending order around the circle.
